d: War has begun - the battle to crown the "Ultimate Soldier"! Trench combat, elite rivalries, and a brutal 3x-harder obstacle course push everyone to their limits. For the first time ever, a mission unfolds inside a real military base. Who will claim the title and its powerful reward?
Nash's investigation into the murder of the Chief of Police puts him in conflict with the DEA  Jake Cage returns, thanks to Caitlin, who assigns his station to the SIU.
Nash goes undercover in Las Vegas to track down the Chief of Police killer and$500 million in missing drug money  Caitlin bids adieu to Nash  and Cassidy reveals her future plans to Evan.
A mad bomber forces Nash to choose between saving Cassidy or Joe.
Cassidy goes undercover to infiltrate a dangerous diamond smuggling ring.

As Luther's affection for Jenny grows, so does his determination to help her back on her feet. But Baba is determined to keep Luther on a tight leash. To add to Luther's difficulties, he is called to investigate a man whose brutal murders seem to have no motive, leaving Jenny vulnerable.

Luther's personal and professional life spirals out of control as he tries to cover up Toby's death and appease Baba. He must also protect Jenny from any further harm. Meanwhile, a killer's at large whose actions are ruled by his dice. How do you stop a man who sees life and death as a game?
